sam1 mask filename does not prove independent human ground truth; verify annotation production and manually audit source masks.
Frame visibility fractions are not query-pixel or semantic keypoint labels.
KU_Leuven_Pallox_284.potential_use: Real target-material/instance segmentation and occluder examples; Pallox walls differ from flat pallets. Source full support needs independent GT mesh/camera/depth validation, no PnP or pose refinement.

next_source_protocol.current_model_preservation: This metadata plan does not alter frozenV4, current inference, prompts, thresholds, checkpoint selection or PnP.
family_gate: Obtain candidate DOI/version, owner, collection site/date, sensor identity, capture sessions and recording ancestry.
Compare candidate ancestry with existing evaluation provenance metadata; same/uncertain family remains quarantined wholesale.
If future intake is authorized, compare candidate SHA256 to existing223 denylist; exact hash independence alone does not exclude re-encodes or neighboring frames.
Require separate recording-family duplicate review; no private-score-driven acquisition, labels, selection, calibration or threshold tuning.
label_gate: Keep visible instance mask, full support, external evidence, outside support and semantic self unknown separate.
Do not rename mask0 as external. Full1vis0 remains a proxy, with uncertainty where no independent occluder/depth evidence supports it.
Independently audit source boundary/hole/occluder masks, especially masks derived from a SAM teacher.
Lock entire environment/recording groups for source TRAIN/VAL before fitting.
next_source_protocol.minimal_future_route: Frozen box-prompt SAM spatial target ownership plus a small zero-initialized RGB/P3 residual at the original query; retain rawSAM baseline and separate exact/nearby labels and corroborated/ambiguous external strata. Any future experiment requires its own source-only frozen protocol.
